summary: Fitzpatrick voted Yea on all 13 tracked Israel/Palestine floor votes in 2023–2024, including three Israel Security Supplemental Appropriations Acts and the Anti-BDS Labeling Act, and co-introduced the Stand With Israel Act to confront anti-Israel bias at the UN. He led a November 2023 resolution demanding Hamas's "immediate, unconditional surrender," voted for and sponsored IHRA-based education enforcement bills, and holds an AIPAC endorsement. His platform opposes one-sided UN resolutions against Israel.
